sections.lede: Liquid-cooled LFP cabinets that sit in front of the charger instead of behind the grid. When the transformer cannot deliver the power, storage decides whether the site is buildable at all.
sections.note: Specifications below are the published configuration; the binding constraint on your site decides the variant.

sections.lede: Capacities, power, cycle life and round-trip efficiency.

rows.v: 120 kWh · 50 kW | 261 kWh · 131 kW | 418 kWh · 209 kW
LFP 3.2 V / 314 Ah · full liquid cooling
120 kWh: PV input up to 100 kWp · 261 kWh: on/off-grid <50 ms · 418 kWh: 1,500 V platform, AC-side parallel to GWh scale
UL 9540A tested · perfluorohexanone suppression · VDE 4105/4110 · EN 50549 · CEI 0-21/0-16

sections.caption: BESS — published specifications

sections.lede: Grid-constrained sites, peak-demand shaving and off-grid deployments where storage is sized before the charger. The pack is rated for 100% depth of discharge with 7,000–10,000 cycle life.

items.title: Typical deployment
items.text: Chosen when the site constraint matches the family, not because it is the cheapest unit.

items.title: What decides the variant
items.text: Grid capacity, duty cycle, climate envelope and connector standard.

items.title: What to send us
items.text: Available kVA, vehicles served per day, dwell time and ambient temperature range.

items.title: How it is delivered
items.text: Within the turnkey scope: design, permits, installation supervision, commissioning and handover.

sections.h2: Send the site parameters and we will return a BESS configuration.
sections.lede: Available capacity, duty cycle and climate are enough to narrow the variant in one exchange.
